implementation: Added nodejs/src/experimental/codexAdapterToolPolicy.ts as a pure dynamic-tool routing policy helper.

Extracted the real protocol-version variation axis: protocol-v2 routes Codex dynamic tool calls through SDK tool.call requests, while protocol-v3 routes through external_tool.requested session events plus session.tools.handlePendingToolCall completion.
Kept gateway IO, timeout handling, transcript recording, and session mutation in CodexCopilotAdapterServer instead of hiding them inside the policy helper.
Added nodejs/test/codex-adapter-tool-policy.test.ts with dedicated protocol-v2 and protocol-v3 variant assertions.
Integrated planDynamicToolCallRouting() into the live adapter dynamic tool path.

noPatternTheaterDecisions.reason: Current approval behavior is already expressed as mapper functions from Codex command/file approval requests to SDK permission requests and from SDK permission results back to Codex decisions. There is no second live approval strategy object beyond the existing request/decision mapping contracts.

Current SDK tool result handling is a single mapper contract that turns textResultForLlm/resultType or explicit errors into Codex dynamic tool responses. Deny/failure are data variants inside the mapper, not separate runtime policies.
The selected profile still has one non-Copilot runtime backend, Codex. A generic runtime framework interface would be speculative until another backend or concrete conformance need exists.
